answer: The voyage is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the pulse. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, voided if the audit panel is not diverse. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Reaching the violet of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys.
